_doc: The factory's ledger. Never edited by hand.
steps: one entry per step that has passed -- when it was stamped, and the sha256 of every file it read and wrote at that moment. A step is stale when one of those files has moved since.
checks: what the last run of a step's checks said, so the reason a step is not done is readable without running them again (some of them are minutes long).

failed: every target judged against the newest measurement
the measured reach against reach.json, in tiles
every target judged over the simulated runs
every gap and ledge against the movement reach
every colour on a role, every text role's contrast over the room behind it
every exit the solver proved, taken by the bot in the engine
clean, committed, tests green, every milestone before this one, played since the last change
